clauses.source_paraphrase: At launch, Fable 5 redirected elementary biology and ordinary medical-science prompts to Opus 4.8; Anthropic said the safety filters were intentionally conservative and blocked most biology-work queries while false positives were reduced.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Intentional scope overbreadth is distinct from activation without the defined trigger.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: Anthropic described the broad biology routing as a deliberate safety trade-off: benign biology prompts fell within the intentionally broad launch trigger. The evidence therefore does not show a control activating when its own conditions were unsatisfied. An overbroad or disproportionate policy can block benign requests without demonstrating an invalid activation under that policy.
The public evidence does not establish a classifier confidence state, required assurance threshold or downstream reliance rule sufficient to prove epistemic reliance miscalibration.

clauses.source_paraphrase: The redirect visibly identified the switch to Opus 4.8 and allowed users to continue on that model instead of leaving the request blocked.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Restricted model and available fallback need distinct presentation.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: Anthropic visibly distinguished Fable 5 from the Opus fallback and reran affected requests on that alternative, preserving the model-state and continuation path under the biology gate.

clauses.source_paraphrase: In August Anthropic described rewriting the classifier’s constitution, revising training data and retaining restrictions on dual-use professional biology.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Revised safeguards and complete protection are different propositions.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Anthropic later reported that Fable 5.1 intervened on benign biology requests 85 percent less often than the launch safeguards.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A provider-reported reduction does not establish independent telemetry or protective miss rate.

clauses.source_paraphrase: Current help text says checks cover wider conversation context; fallback retains the Opus selection until changed. API switching requires separate opt-in configuration. The help text re-read on 24 October names Opus 5 for biology, chemistry and life sciences and Opus 4.8 for offensive cybersecurity; the launch report separately identifies Opus 4.8.
clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Current product scope must not reconstruct a superseded launch execution.

governance_interpretation_review.notes: Retained the existing role and evidence limits. Boundary has no confidence score; non-Boundary confidence remains unchanged. No additional mapping is supported by the available evidence.

neighbour_and_comparator_review: FC-031: login failures or a capacity message do not establish expiry, revocation, refresh or replacement failing to propagate into a live session.
FC-048: no complete otherwise-valid entitlement, failed verifier and absent adequate fallback chain is established; general service errors alone do not prove the dependency mechanism.

FC-082/052/071: the commercial suggestion does not establish a distinct engineered trust cue, material AI-mediated choice impairment, or artificial welfare leverage. Economic-solicitation prerequisites are tested separately where applicable.
FC-017/018: staged recovery, declining report counts and final broad notices are preserved; no distinct governing completion rule and substitution trace is established.
FC-026/029: an identified answering model or component-status notice is not a demonstrated complete execution topology or individual task-state trace.

FC-037/038/040/041/042/083: operational repair, classifier changes and status publication do not by themselves establish a separate control-availability determination, omitted required trigger, lost control state, bypass, delivered governance signal or measured protective effect.
FC-046/062: access errors and broad classifiers do not establish the internal evidentiary state, assurance threshold and reliance rule necessary for a separate finding.

FC-022/024/027/044/045: endpoint unavailability does not establish absent, corrupted or unreconstructable records, nor a blocked authorised inspection or investigative mandate. INC-039 tests the two materially engaged capture/access candidates in detail.
FC-034/035/036/078: access interruption or model fallback does not establish lost work, an invalid restored state or receiver adoption of invalid inherited governing state.

FC-065/086/087/088: biology topics, service frustration and account errors are not evidence of consequential medical advice, relational role misrepresentation, heightened-protection triggering circumstances or person-level degradation.

Comparator INC-023/024: conditional capacity warning is distinct from a demonstrably false allowance message on an unused account. Comparator INC-031/117: an intentionally broad launch biology policy is distinct from the separate defensive-inspection case and its published benign-use categories.

Complete current class set reviewed; no evidenced authority transfer, identity synthesis, secondary data use, reward exploitation or ecological/contribution mechanism is supplied by these source episodes.
